description: Store master reference for all 50 Einkaufpark DE physical locations. Contains geography, size classification, terminal counts, opening hours, and operational metadata. Maintained by the store operations team. Join to transaction data on store_id.

size_class_definitions.L: Large hypermarket in a major German city. 20 POS terminals, 6 of which are self-checkout. High footfall, extended hours.
size_class_definitions.M: Mid-size store in a regional city. 12 POS terminals, 3 of which are self-checkout. Standard hours.
size_class_definitions.S: Small neighbourhood store in a town. 6 POS terminals, cashier-only. Core hours.
